remarks: Charming 1-Bedroom Apartment in Norwalk - All Utilities Included!  Discover comfort and convenience in this cozy 1-bedroom, 1-bath lower-level apartment located in the vibrant town of Norwalk. This well-maintained unit offers an effortless living experience with ALL utilities heat, water, and electricity already included in the rent, making budgeting simple and stress-free.  Enjoy the ease of plenty of on-street parking and an unbeatable location just minutes from public transportation, offering quick access to surrounding towns and commuting routes. You'll also be steps away from fantastic restaurants, local shops, and Norwalk's lively nightlife, giving you endless options for dining and entertainment.  Perfect for anyone seeking an affordable, well-located home in a bustling community, schedule a viewing today and make this inviting apartment yours!
